title: Peruvian Vegan Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Peruvian-inspired stew made with a variety of vegetables and spices, perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Heat the Vegan Broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Onions and Warmly Spiced Peppers to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Canned Tomatoes, Potatoes, Carrots, and Zucchini to the pot.
Stir in the Spicy Stew Seasoning and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
